_nota: Esempio di manifest per `python3 -m pubblicita.ephone batch`. Copialo (es. in pubblicita/seedance/manifest.json), cambia le variabili col soggetto dello spot e lancia prima `estimate`. Ogni setup produce un clip da 5 s in pubblicita/output/seedance/<id>.mp4; il montaggio ne ritaglia piu' shot (il reel di riferimento fa 26 tagli da circa 10 setup). I prompt vanno in inglese: l'italiano non e' fra le lingue supportate da Seedance.
_modalita: Per agganciare un clip al blockout Blender: aggiungi allo shot "first_frame": "../output/blender/<setup>_first.png" (percorso relativo a questo file; still renderizzato con --still) oppure, con il render ospitato a un URL pubblico, "reference_videos": [{"url": "https://.../setup01.mp4", "duration_s": 5}] con "omni_reference_task_type": "reference". first_frame e reference_* si escludono.

variabili.soggetto: a glossy white-and-black 1980s sports coupe with pop-up headlights
variabili.personaggio: a young woman in an elegant traditional outfit
variabili.luogo: a neon-lit Japanese city street at night with wet asphalt and light rain
variabili.stile: photorealistic cinematic commercial, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, neon reflections, smooth motion

shots.prompt: Establishing aerial shot slowly descending over $luogo; $soggetto drives into frame from the bottom and crosses the intersection. $stile.

shots._blockout: carrello laterale basso accanto al soggetto
shots.prompt: Low tracking shot alongside $soggetto moving at speed through $luogo, camera at wheel height, wheels spinning, reflections streaking on the bodywork. $stile.

shots._blockout: dettaglio fisso con cambio di fuoco
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up detail of $soggetto: headlights open and light up, rack focus from the emblem to the headlight glow, rain drops on the surface. $stile.

shots._blockout: piano medio, push-in lento sul personaggio
shots.prompt: Medium shot of $personaggio standing under a neon sign in $luogo, she turns her head toward the camera, slow push-in, hair moving in the wind. $stile.

shots._blockout: over-the-shoulder dal personaggio verso la strada
shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind $personaggio watching $soggetto approach down the street and stop in front of her, headlights flaring into the lens. $stile.

shots._blockout: tre quarti frontale fisso, passaggio ravvicinato
shots.prompt: Static front three-quarter hero shot at ground level: $soggetto rushes past very close to the lens, spray of water from the tires, strong motion blur. $stile.
Interior shot from the passenger seat of $soggetto, glowing analog dashboard, city lights sliding across the windshield, hands on the steering wheel shifting gear. $stile.
Top-down overhead shot of a neon-lit intersection in $luogo; $soggetto drifts through the corner leaving light trails and splashes on the wet asphalt. $stile.

shots._blockout: panoramica a schiaffo (whip pan) che segue il passaggio
shots.prompt: Fast whip pan following $soggetto as it flies by, heavy horizontal motion blur, neon colors smeared into streaks, energetic transition shot. $stile.

shots._blockout: orbita lenta finale, soggetto e personaggio insieme
shots.prompt: Final hero shot: slow orbit around $soggetto parked in $luogo with $personaggio leaning against it, she looks into the camera, neon reflections in the puddles. $stile.
